answer: Each challenge is bound to an anchor commitment and a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value is unknowable when work begins. The pulse, released after the commit window, derives the task instance or verifier salt, while a commit-reveal response proves timely work; precomputed tables and offline farming therefore cannot anticipate valid answers. A lantern nonce and haven identity add no leverage: spawning sybil accounts merely repeats unpredictable work without increasing selection power.
